messages.author: f06db63329fab1f9
messages.subject: Re: Stack Traces
parts:
there is actually no ncol attribute, ncol() just returns the second element of the "dim" attribute. So if you want to build a matrix in R from scratch, you could do:

x <- 1:12

dim(x) <- c(3,4)

ncol(x) # 4

nrow(x) # 3

Likewise you can define x as a higher-dimension array by doing:

dim(x) <- c(2,2,3)

If you're building matrix objects from Java/Scala, you can use the DoubleMatrixBuilder for convenience. 

HTH,
Alex
